questions.question: Name the six main parts of a plant and give the job of each.
questions.expected_answer: Roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water and minerals. The stem holds the plant up and carries water and food. Leaves make food using sunlight. Flowers attract insects and birds and help make seeds. Fruits hold and protect the seeds. Seeds grow into new plants.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a tap root and fibrous roots, with an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A tap root is one big main root that grows straight down with small roots off its sides, like a carrot or a bean. Fibrous roots are many thin roots spreading out in all directions, like grass or maize.

questions.question: Give one difference in size, one in shape and one in colour between two plants.
questions.expected_answer: Example answers: size, a baobab tree is huge while a pond plant is tiny; shape, a pumpkin leaf is wide and flat while a pine leaf is thin like a needle; colour, marigold flowers are orange while jacaranda flowers are purple.
